heroHeadline: Day 804: At Least 12 Dead in Sinaloa Over Two Days as Mazatlán Sees Six Killings
heroSubtitle: 804 days of cartel civil war: between October 2 and 3, at least 12 people were found dead across Mazatlán, Culiacán and Ahome, including a suspect shot at a federal checkpoint and two municipal police officers wounded near Mazatlán airport.
